name: postcurve-canary
description: Early warning that exposed elliptic-curve keys may be breaking: a Chainlink CRE workflow, its watchlist builder and a staged devnet demo

scripts.watchlist:devnet: bun run watchlist/build-watchlist.ts --chain-id 1337 --chain-label "local EIP-8141 devnet (ethrex, chain id 1337)" --from-block 0 --step 1 --min-tx-value-eth 1 --min-balance-eth 100 --labels .state/demo-labels.json --out watchlist/watchlist.devnet.json
